reason: VietQR plus a VAT invoice with our tax code fixes exactly what blocks me with foreign cards, so I'd burn the 50k free credit and maybe do one small top-up. But I've been burned by a tool that shut down, so I won't put real money in until I've seen an invoice my accountant accepts.
objection: Is the e-invoice really valid for my company's books, and will this company still be around in six months to refund my balance?
